label: Level
description: país (Brasil), UF (Unidade da Federação: the 26 states and the Distrito Federal) or município

label: UF
description: The UF a município lies in, as the workbook abbreviates it (column UF); empty for the country and the UFs

label: Unit
description: The unit's name as the workbook writes it: Brasil; the UF's abbreviation (the workbook gives no full names); the município's name (NOME DO MUNICÍPIO)

label: COD. UF
description: The UF's 2-digit IBGE code; empty for the country

label: Código IBGE do município
description: The município's 7-digit IBGE code: COD. UF followed by COD. MUNIC (5 digits); empty for the country and the UFs

label: POP. TOTAL
description: Total population, collected plus imputed, 2022 census

label: Table
description: The workbook sheet the row was read from

label: Cells
description: The workbook cells the row was read from
